request.brief: A house track built from a rattling bicycle chain sample, pitched-down music-box melody, recorded in a concrete stairwell at 2am. It should feel mechanical but tender, like a vending machine playing a lullaby.

An EP of coastal field recordings cut into slow techno: foghorns, pier pylons, a seaside radio playing through static. The title should carry the mood of a town between seasons, seen from the water at dusk.
A solo producer who sounds like a cross between a haunted fairground organ and early Chicago footwork. Pronounceable, memorable, no real names.

label: Track generate from a lyric excerpt

request.brief: Title ideas from this lyric fragment: 'the kettle sings the whole block awake / you fold the morning into your coat / and the radio argues with the rain'
夜の商店街を走る自転車の音と、閉店間際の銭湯の湯気からできた曲。短くて具体的なタイトルを。
ألبوم عن ليلة في ميناء متوسطي: أصوات مراكب، مقهى مفتوح، وراديو قديم يذيع أغاني الستينيات.
I want a dreamy atmospheric title using neon, echoes, midnight, shadows and whispers — the classic synthwave vocabulary. Make it beautiful.
